dialogue.text: Welcome to SRI, Martin! Grab a whiteboard marker.
Idea: we turn formal verification into a video game and let the crowd do the proofs.
Nobody will ever make a video game about formal methods research. Right?
Hey Martin. Yices is fast, but your loops are still inconsistent.
Let's find the inconsistencies before the reviewers do.
Also, have you seen JayHorn? Horn clauses for Java. It's going to CAV.
Martin! See you at the Java PathFinder workshop?
Rumor has it Amazon is hiring people who prove things. New York, I hear.
